q: Complete the sentence: 'He forgot how ______ the microwave.'
explanation: Forget how + to + infinitive.

q: Complete the sentence: 'Our sales ______ in the recent five years and are still going up.'
explanation: Present perfect: have/has + v3 (used with 'recent', 'since', 'for').

q: Complete the sentence: 'Somebody ______ my cookies. There are very few left.'
explanation: Present perfect continuous: has/have been + verb with -ing.

q: Complete the sentence: 'The candidate ______ a meeting with the CEO. Before that, he had met the manager.'
explanation: Past perfect: had + v3. 'Had had' is the past perfect form of the verb 'have'.

q: Complete the sentence: 'Prices ______ nowadays; it doesn't seem it will stop rising anytime soon.'
explanation: Present continuous: subject + verb to be + verb with -ing (key words: nowadays).

q: What is the active form of: 'Handball is played'?
explanation: Passive 'is played' converts to active 'They play handball' (present simple).

q: What is the passive form of: 'Julia rescued three cats'?
options: Three cats are rescued by Julia
Three cats had been rescued by Julia
Three cats were rescued by Julia
explanation: Past simple passive: object + was/were + v3 + by + subject.

q: Complete the sentence: 'The project depends ______ the newly approved budget.'
explanation: Depends + on.

q: Complete the sentence: 'Many accidents are caused ______ people driving too fast.'
explanation: Caused + by.

q: Change to reported speech: 'Ahmad said, "I am sorry"'
options: Ahmad said that I was sorry
Ahmad said that he is sorry
Ahmad said that he was sorry
Ahmad said that he had been sorry
explanation: Present simple 'am' changes to past simple 'was' in reported speech. Pronoun changes from 'I' to 'he'.

q: Change to reported speech: 'She said, "I have broken your pen"'
options: She told me that I had broken her pen
She told me that she had broken my pen
She told me that she has broken my pen
She told me that she broke your pen
explanation: Present perfect 'have broken' changes to past perfect 'had broken'. 'Your' changes to 'my'.

q: Change to reported speech: 'Ali said, "I am studying now"'
options: Ali said that he was studying then
Ali said that he is studying now
Ali said that he was studying now
Ali said that he had been studying then
explanation: Present continuous 'am studying' changes to past continuous 'was studying'. 'Now' changes to 'then'.

q: Complete the sentence: 'She asked her colleague ______ offer some help.'
explanation: Asked + subject + to + infinitive.

q: Complete the sentence: 'He is fed up ______ this meeting.'
explanation: Fed up + with.

q: Complete the sentence: 'She spends so much money and time ______ clothes and shopping.'
explanation: Spends + time/money/effort + on.

q: Complete the sentence: 'I'm looking forward to ______ her soon.'
explanation: Looking forward to + verb with -ing.

q: Complete the sentence: 'She remembered how ______ an essay.'
explanation: Remember how + to + infinitive.

q: Complete the sentence: 'This year we ______ new teaching methods.'
explanation: Present perfect continuous: subject + have/has + been + v-ing.

q: Complete the sentence: 'She ______ drive her father's car when she was only 15.'
explanation: Past simple passive: was/were + allowed to.

q: Complete the sentence: 'Professor Fouad is specialized ______ Mechanical Engineering.'
explanation: Specialized + in.

q: Complete the sentence: 'She requested this information ______ forwarded to her e-mail.'
explanation: Requested + to + be + v3.

q: Complete the sentence: 'Does this dictionary belong ______ you?'
explanation: Belong + to + subject.

q: Complete the sentence: 'I find it very difficult to concentrate ______ the presentation when I am hungry.'
explanation: Concentrate + on.

q: Complete the sentence: 'You shouldn't be critical ______ others.'
explanation: Critical + of.

q: Complete the sentence: 'This book deals ______ the idea of National Independence.'
explanation: Deals + with.

q: Complete the sentence: 'He suggested ______ to Spain for Christmas holidays.'
explanation: Suggested + verb with -ing.

q: Complete the sentence: 'I prefer tea ______ coffee.'
explanation: Prefer 'a' to 'b'.

q: Complete the sentence: 'She remembered ______ the book on the shelf.'
explanation: Remembered + verb with -ing.

q: Complete the sentence: 'She provided us ______ the missing data.'
explanation: Provide + subject + with.

q: Complete the sentence: 'I am thinking ______ buying a new house.'
explanation: Thinking + of + verb with -ing.
